items.desc: orange carrot with leafy tops
items.note: Carrots used to be purple

items.desc: green tree frog sitting, with red eyes and orange toes
items.note: A group of frogs is called an army

items.desc: blue and white toothbrush, side view showing the bristles
items.note: The first bristle toothbrushes used hog hair

items.desc: watermelon wedge with red flesh, black seeds and striped green rind
items.note: A watermelon is about 92 percent water

items.desc: brown barn owl perched, with a heart-shaped white face
items.note: An owl can turn its head about 270 degrees

items.desc: old glass mercury thermometer with a red column and printed scale on a wooden backing
items.note: Fahrenheit set 0 at the coldest temperature he could make with ice and salt

items.desc: pair of steel pliers with red rubber handles
items.note: Pliers go back to Bronze Age blacksmiths

items.desc: wooden rocking chair with curved runners, three-quarter view
items.note: Benjamin Franklin is often said to have invented it

items.desc: red helicopter with main rotor blades and a tail rotor, side view
items.note: Leonardo da Vinci sketched a screw-shaped helicopter in the 1480s

items.desc: red wooden yo-yo with its string wound and a loop at the end
items.note: In 1985 a yo-yo went to space on the shuttle Discovery

items.desc: snare drum with a chrome shell, white head and a pair of drumsticks
items.note: The wires underneath give it its sharp rattle

items.desc: platypus with a brown furry body, a flat duck-like bill and webbed feet
items.note: A mammal that lays eggs

items.desc: star-shaped piñata with colourful paper fringes and cone points
items.note: Piñatas came to Mexico by way of Spain, and maybe China before that

items.desc: antique black sewing machine with gold decoration and a hand wheel
items.note: The needle's eye is near its tip, not the top

items.desc: blue and white personal watercraft jet ski, three-quarter view
items.names: jet ski, jetski, personal watercraft, waverunner, sea-doo
items.note: It moves by pumping a jet of water out the back

items.desc: black rotary dial telephone with a coiled cord
items.names: rotary phone, rotary telephone, dial phone, telephone, phone
items.note: Dialling a 0 took the longest, ten clicks

items.desc: set of Russian nesting dolls, painted red and gold, in a row from big to small
items.names: matryoshka, nesting dolls, russian dolls, babushka dolls, stacking dolls
items.note: The first set, from 1890, had eight dolls

items.desc: fennec fox, small sandy fox with huge ears, sitting
items.note: Its huge ears let heat escape in the desert

items.desc: didgeridoo, a long wooden wind tube painted with Aboriginal dot patterns
items.note: Players keep a drone going by breathing in through the nose while blowing

items.desc: laboratory Bunsen burner with a blue flame on top of the metal tube and a rubber gas hose
items.note: The collar at the bottom lets in air for a hotter blue flame

items.desc: cast-iron bench vise painted blue, with steel jaws and a T-shaped handle
items.names: vise, vice, bench vise, bench vice
items.note: The screw gives a huge squeeze from a small push

items.desc: whole jackfruit with bumpy spiky green-yellow skin next to a cut piece showing yellow pods
items.note: The largest tree fruit: one can weigh over 40 kilograms

items.desc: mangosteen fruit, round dark purple rind with a green cap, one opened to show white segments
items.note: Called the queen of fruits

items.desc: hovercraft with a black rubber skirt and a big rear propeller fan
items.note: It floats on a cushion of air, so it can cross land and water

items.desc: proboscis monkey with reddish fur and a large long drooping nose, sitting
items.note: The big nose may make its honking call louder

items.desc: Japanese koto, a long wooden zither lying flat, with 13 strings over movable white bridges
items.note: Its bridges are moved to tune each string

items.desc: brass clockwork orrery model of the solar system, with planet balls on arms around a central sun
items.note: Named after the Earl of Orrery, who owned an early one

items.desc: black tricorne hat with three sides of the brim turned up into a triangle, with gold trim
items.names: tricorne, tricorn, tricorn hat, tricorne hat, three-cornered hat, ?hat, ?pirate hat
items.note: The turned-up brim kept rain off and let soldiers carry muskets on the shoulder

items.desc: old woodworking adze, a long wooden handle with a curved steel blade set crosswise like a hoe
items.note: The blade runs across the handle, unlike an axe
